description: versus-2p-bamboo with column 1 of g_gpu_fog_move_settings (0x800906A4, d_80DF8.c:59, 38 rows {1, 0} and a {0, 0} terminator) poked to 1 in all 38 rows at the top menu (a modified game; column 0 stays 1): gpu_LatchFogDepthOnTransitionAndQueueMoves (2B344.c:1515-1521) passes it as link_last_depth_entry to gpu_QueueDepthSpacedMovesAndLinkTerminalPacket, which then queues one more DR_MOVE and calls gpu_SetLastDepthIndexOtEntryLinkToPacket (2B344.c:1576-1577) instead of adding the terminal packet at OT entry 0xFFB; every screen from the fight load on is black
